cards.etymology: Cow (牛) + a waving banner (勿) — a cow marked as a distinct thing.
A bird perched on a branch — the profile of a bird.
Grain (米) measured with a ladle (斗) — measured ingredients, a fee.
King (王) + village (里) — the king's orderly management of the village.
Cow (牛) + temple (寺) — a bull kept at the temple for special ceremonies.
A woman (女) under a roof (宀) — a woman safe at home.
Food (食) + return/turn (反) — food that is turned/worked over, cooked rice.
A cut of meat on ribs — the shape of a piece of meat.
A heart (心) trapped under a cover (亜) — a heart in a bad place.
Person (亻) + root/main (本) — the main substance of a person.
A mouth (口) inside a shared enclosure (冂) — all saying the same thing.
A sheep (羊) with eyes (目) at the bottom — settling down on arrival.
A cave (穴) where work (工) is done — hollowed out, empty sky.
Water (氵) + common (巷) — where all vessels commonly gather.
A finger pointing to the sun at its peak — high noon.
Water (氵) + mother (毎) — the mother of all waters, the sea.
Twenty days (廿) above the sun (日) — twenty days have passed, it was long ago.
Altar (礻) beside lightning from the sky (申) — where the divine appears.
The sun (日) above a ten (十) — the sun just barely risen, early morning.
Run (走) + self (己) — yourself getting up and running.
Person (亻) + official (吏) — a person put to official use.
Person (亻) who moves (動) — one who moves is one who works.
Another piece (刂) cut by a knife — divided and separate.
Under a shelter (广), a hand (又) measuring — a measured degree.
Big person (大) + fire (灬) — a person in firelight, flushed red.
Growing plants (生) beneath the moon (月) — the blue-green of nature.
A person (人) kneeling with a cover — blushing, showing one's colors.
The sun (日) with a ray — the first ray of white dawn.
Fire (灬) blackening a window (里) — soot-blackened darkness.
Heavy (重) + strength/force (力) — applying force to move something heavy.
Move (辶) with a soldier (軍) — moving things around, luck depends on movement.
Filial piety (孝) with a striking rod — using force to instill lessons.
Roof (宀) + arrive (至) — reaching the shelter, a room.
A hand (ナ) holding meat (月) — having something in hand.
A banner (方) with a person following — marching on a journey.
Standing (立) + tree (木) + see (見) — a parent watching from atop the tree.

Hill (阝) + a footprint heading down — stepping down from a hill.
Walking (彳) + temple (寺) — walking to the temple and waiting there.
Hand (扌) + temple (寺) — a hand holding steady like a temple.
The sun (日) rising — a standing (立) sun creates the sound of day.
A tree (木) with bells (白×2) — a musical tree, joyful.
Quiver (匸) of arrows + a hand — reaching into the quiver of remedies.
Old person (老) simplified — a marked person, someone defined by a role.
Bones (歹) + person kneeling (匕) — a person bowing before death.
Sound (音) over heart (心) — what the heart sounds like, intention.
Mouth (口) + not yet ripe (未) — savoring something not yet familiar.
Water (氵) + master (主) — the master pouring, directing attention.
A person (頁) with elaborate headdress dancing in the heat.
A complete fish shape — head, body, fins, tail.
Ground (土) + a hand with measuring stick (寸) — a measured ground, a temple.
A shelter (广) with only space inside — wide open.
A knee and foot — the lower leg.
Cart (車) rotating (専) — wheels rolling.

Walking (辶) + overturn (反) — turning back to return something.
Roof (宀) + a hundred (百) people — many people under one roof, an inn.
Is (是) + page/head (頁) — the leading idea on the page.
Cart (車) + channels (巠) — a cart with smooth wheels, light to pull.
Sun (日) + sound barrier (音) — the sun blocked, darkness.
A phoenix (鳳 simplified) — the wind like a great bird in motion.
Earth (土) + sun rising (昜) — a sun-lit open place.
Feet (癶) and a bow releasing (弓) — launching forward.
Walking (辶) with an axe (斤) — approaching to chop nearby trees.
Walking (辶) a long swirling (袁) road — going far away.
Walking (辶) with efficiency (束) — moving quickly along a path.

A musical instrument (殸) simplified — the sound a person makes.
Sun (日) + center (央) — light at the center, projecting outward.
A brush tracing a field border — drawing a picture.
A possible yawn (可) + exhale (欠) — opening wide to sing.
A roof (宀) + give (与) — under a roof, transferring an image.
A spoon filling a frame — seeing things truly, as they are.
A mound (阝) + a city quarter (咅) — a section of the city.
Roof (宀) + hole (穴) + heart (心) — a hole in the roof that lets light into the heart.

Water (氵) + fresh/first (先) — rinsing fresh with water.

Woman (女) + not yet ripe (未) — the younger sister.
A pig (豕) under a roof (宀) — a house with livestock.
A banner (方) with arrows (矢) — a tribe rallying under their banner.

Words (言) + I/myself (吾) — the words that express myself.

A window (囗) with an opening (口) — turned to face out.
Woman (女) + platform (台) — a woman standing on a platform to begin.
Thread (糸) + winter/end (冬) — thread running out at winter's end.

A handle on a rod pointing in a direction.
Standing timber (立木) + axe (斤) — freshly chopped wood, new.
Sun (日) + moon (月) — both luminaries together, very bright.
A tall tower on a base — towering high.

Tree (木) + sheep (羊) + water (氵) — layered beauty, an elegant appearance.
